node.statement: Concrete non-entailment model: take the exact C*-algebra A=C with epsilon=delta=0 and P=Q=R=S=1. Then the level-one corner is C with <y,v>=conj(y)v, so the registered level-one identity y^dagger dot v=<y,v>*u_Q holds with u_Q=1. At n=2, because no allowed input fixes the amplified normalization, interpret the datum’s amplified sesquilinear form as <Y,V>_2 prime :=2*sum_{i=1}^2 conj(Y_i)V_i. This is a sesquilinear form and preserves every stated level-one definition and the H-CB datum as currently registered, but for Y=V=(1,0) one has sum_i<Y_i,V_i>=1 whereas <Y,V>_2 prime=2. Thus the coefficient-one direct-sum formula is genuinely independent of the allowed inputs, exactly as the challenge asserts.
